obligations.statement: join succeeding in started leaves the object in empty.
premises: the state started is state_ != nullptr && !(*state_).joined (the declaration's represents)
a member is named with a trailing underscore (AGENTS.md), so a call whose receiver and arguments name none, nor this, nor something a state member is a field of, does not change the state
a function called inside a condition only reads
atomic loads and stores read as plain ones: one thread acts on the object at a time, as the declaration's thread rule says
success is result == JoinResult::joined (the declaration's represents.succeeds)
